title: The flat pullback commutes with the base change pullback
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-setup-base-change, for Y -> X -> S locally of finite type with flat f : Y -> X of relative dimension r and base changes by S' -> S, the lemma asserts that f' : Y' -> X' is flat of relative dimension r and that the two squares relating the cycle groups Z and the Chow groups CH commute (statement lines 15301-15323). The proof reduces to the cycle level: for an integral closed subscheme Z of delta-dimension k with base change Z', one has g^*[Z] = [Z']_{k+c} by construction, and (f')^*g^*[Z] = [Z' x_{X'} Y']_{k+c+r} by Lemma labelled lemma-pullback-coherent; on the other side f^*[Z] = [Z x_X Y]_{k+r} by Definition labelled definition-flat-pullback and g^*f^*[Z] = [(Z x_X Y)']_{k+r+c} by Lemma labelled lemma-pullback-coherent-base-change, after which associativity of the fibre product identifies the two (proof lines 15325-15337). Tracking the two degree shifts c and r and matching the base changes of the fibre product is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
